# WAS_mme_Weighted { #wass2s.WAS_mme_Weighted }

```python
WAS_mme_Weighted(
    equal_weighted=False,
    dist_method='nonparam',
    metric='GROC',
    threshold=0.5,
)
```

Equal- or skill-weighted deterministic MME with tercile probabilities.

All public outputs are dimension-safe:

* :meth:`compute` returns ``(T, Y, X)`` deterministic arrays;
* :meth:`compute_prob` returns ``(probability, T, Y, X)``;
* :meth:`forecast` returns the same deterministic/probabilistic conventions.

Score arrays are reduced to ``(Y, X)`` before weighting, so an accidental
score member dimension can never propagate into the deterministic result.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit](#wass2s.WAS_mme_Weighted.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit) | Compute PB/PN/PA for one grid cell and all requested times. |
| [compute](#wass2s.WAS_mme_Weighted.compute) | Compute equal- or skill-weighted deterministic hindcast/forecast. |
| [compute_prob](#wass2s.WAS_mme_Weighted.compute_prob) | Convert deterministic hindcasts into tercile probabilities. |
| [forecast](#wass2s.WAS_mme_Weighted.forecast) | Convert a deterministic forecast into tercile probabilities. |
| [transform_score](#wass2s.WAS_mme_Weighted.transform_score) | Convert a score field into non-negative spatial weights. |

### calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit { #wass2s.WAS_mme_Weighted.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit }

```python
WAS_mme_Weighted.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit(
    best_guess,
    error_variance,
    T1,
    T2,
    dist_code,
    dof,
)
```

Compute PB/PN/PA for one grid cell and all requested times.

### compute { #wass2s.WAS_mme_Weighted.compute }

```python
WAS_mme_Weighted.compute(rainfall, hdcst, fcst, scores, complete=False)
```

Compute equal- or skill-weighted deterministic hindcast/forecast.

### compute_prob { #wass2s.WAS_mme_Weighted.compute_prob }

```python
WAS_mme_Weighted.compute_prob(
    Predictant,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
    hindcast_det,
    best_code_da=None,
    best_shape_da=None,
    best_loc_da=None,
    best_scale_da=None,
)
```

Convert deterministic hindcasts into tercile probabilities.

### forecast { #wass2s.WAS_mme_Weighted.forecast }

```python
WAS_mme_Weighted.forecast(
    Predictant,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
    hindcast_det,
    forecast_det,
    best_code_da=None,
    best_shape_da=None,
    best_loc_da=None,
    best_scale_da=None,
)
```

Convert a deterministic forecast into tercile probabilities.

### transform_score { #wass2s.WAS_mme_Weighted.transform_score }

```python
WAS_mme_Weighted.transform_score(score_array)
```

Convert a score field into non-negative spatial weights.
